d: Disney's magic may be fading as the entertainment giant reportedly considers thousands of job cuts and a 20% cost-saving drive. But this is bigger than just Mickey Mouse. Hollywood is battling rising production costs, industry consolidation, shifting audience habits, artificial intelligence and a growing streaming crisis. With subscriptions getting more expensive and viewers increasingly spoilt for choice, entertainment companies are facing tough questions about profitability and the future of content.
